answer: Every new identity must be vouched at a distinct vertex of a reputation graph, and only after publishing an original sonnet tying its history to that node. Each agent must stake tokens and solve a unique proof-of-work whose difficulty scales with its identity's age in a spiral, so creating fresh sybils grows costlier each round. Fake clusters collapse because duplicated work fails peer review, making mass forgery exceed the reward. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
